subject: The Brine Hag, an old sea-witch who traded her reflection to the tide for the right to keep yours, standing hunched with salt-crusted hands
detail: the same figure as her shipped painting; her feet stay on one line in every cell so the set anchors on the foot line

poses: idle, a slow breathing sway that ends where it began
struck, recoiling from a blow and recovering to her stance
attacking, raising both hands and casting toward the viewer, then settling back

avoid: no water splashes crossing cell borders
